policy.question: How long does standard delivery take after dispatch?

answer.answer: Standard delivery typically takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch.

evidence.title: Delivery and tracking
evidence.content: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days after dispatch. A tracking link appears in My Orders once the parcel is dispatched. If a parcel is overdue, the support agent must verify the order number and tracking status before escalating to the carrier. The application cannot verify a live parcel location or promise a new arrival date.

policy.question: Where do I find my parcel tracking link?

answer.answer: To find your parcel tracking link, go to My Orders and look for the "Track Order" option.

evidence.title: Delivery and tracking

The application cannot verify a live parcel location or promise a new arrival date.

policy.question: Can I cancel an order before dispatch?

answer.answer: Yes, you can cancel an order before dispatch through My Orders.

evidence.title: Cancel an order
evidence.content: An order can be cancelled before dispatch through My Orders. Dispatched orders cannot be cancelled; the customer can request a return after delivery. A support agent must confirm the dispatch state before confirming cancellation. Cancellation eligibility does not mean a cancellation has been executed.

policy.question: Can a dispatched order still be cancelled?

answer.answer: A dispatched order cannot be cancelled directly. The customer should request a return after delivery if they need to cancel. Human review may be needed for more detailed assistance.

evidence.title: Cancel an order
evidence.content: An order can be cancelled before dispatch through My Orders. Dispatched orders cannot be cancelled; the customer can request a return after delivery. A support agent must confirm the dispatch state before confirming cancellation. Cancellation eligibility does not mean a cancellation has been executed.

policy.question: Can I change the shipping address before dispatch?

answer.answer: Yes, you can change the shipping address before dispatch if there's still stock available and the new address is serviceable. Save your preferred shipping address in Account Settings for future reference. Always check the order record before confirming any changes.

evidence.title: Change an order or address
evidence.content: Order contents and delivery addresses can be changed before dispatch, subject to stock and address serviceability. After dispatch, changes are not guaranteed and require carrier review. Customers can save a shipping address in Account Settings. Never confirm an address or order change without checking the order record.

policy.question: What is the time limit for requesting a return?

answer.answer: The time limit for requesting a return is 14 calendar days from delivery.

evidence.title: Returns and refunds
evidence.content: A return request must be raised within 14 calendar days of delivery. Items must be unused and include the original packaging. Damaged or incorrect items require photographs for review. Once the returned item is received and inspected, an eligible refund is issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days. Customers can view an existing refund in My Orders. A support agent must verify the actual return and refund records before confirming approval, issue, receipt or payment status.

policy.question: How long does an eligible refund take after inspection?

answer.answer: An eligible refund takes approximately 5 to 7 business days from when the returned item is received and inspected. Customers can check their existing refund in My Orders.

evidence.title: Returns and refunds
evidence.content: A return request must be raised within 14 calendar days of delivery. Items must be unused and include the original packaging. Damaged or incorrect items require photographs for review. Once the returned item is received and inspected, an eligible refund is issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days. Customers can view an existing refund in My Orders. A support agent must verify the actual return and refund records before confirming approval, issue, receipt or payment status.

policy.question: Do you accept UPI and debit cards?

answer.answer: Yes, we accept UPI and debit cards. For more details on payments, visit My Orders.

evidence.title: Payments and invoices
evidence.content: The store accepts credit cards, debit cards and UPI. Never request a full card number, CVV, OTP or UPI PIN. If a payment appears debited but the order is unconfirmed, the customer should provide the order reference and transaction reference to support through the secure account form. Invoices for confirmed orders can be downloaded from My Orders. A missing or incorrect invoice requires order verification; do not invent an invoice or confirm payment reversal.

policy.question: What should I check when my account registration email fails?

answer.answer: Check if your email is already registered and verify the email address by checking spam folders.

evidence.title: Create or edit an account
evidence.content: Customers can create an account with an email address and complete email verification. Profile details can be edited in Account Settings. For registration issues, check whether the email is already registered and whether the verification email is in spam. Support must not ask for the account password or verification code.

policy.question: How can I reset a forgotten password?

answer.answer: Resetting a forgotten password involves going to the sign-in page, clicking "Forgot Password," following the reset link sent to your registered email, signing out of any existing account, and then switching to the new one. For more detailed steps, refer to the Account Access and Closure policy.

evidence.title: Account access and closure
evidence.content: To recover access, use Forgot Password on the sign-in page and follow the reset link sent to the registered email. Sign out before switching to another account. Account deletion requests are made through Account Settings and require identity verification in the secure account flow. The support application cannot reset passwords, delete accounts or verify identity itself.

policy.question: Where can I request deletion of my account?

answer.answer: Human review is needed.

evidence.title: Account access and closure

policy.question: What are the customer service opening hours?

answer.answer: The customer service hours are Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00 IST. For more details or to request a human review, visit the Help page.

evidence.title: Customer service and escalation
evidence.content: Customer service is available Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00 IST. Customers can request human review through the Help page. Support agents can record an escalation request in a case, but must not promise a callback time or completed transfer without confirmation from the support team.

policy.question: How can I raise a complaint about my order?

answer.answer: To raise a complaint about your order, visit Help and provide the order reference along with a detailed description of the issue.

evidence.title: Feedback and complaints
evidence.content: Customers can leave a review on the product page after purchase or raise a complaint through Help. A complaint should include the order reference and a clear description. The team reviews complaints and requests any missing information. Do not claim that compensation or a replacement has been approved without an authorised decision.

policy.question: How can I stop the newsletter emails?

answer.answer: To stop newsletter emails, go to Account Settings or use the unsubscribe link in the email.

evidence.title: Newsletter preferences
evidence.content: Newsletter preferences can be changed in Account Settings or through the unsubscribe link in the email. Transactional order and security messages continue even when marketing newsletters are disabled.

policy.question: Is there a cancellation fee before dispatch?

answer.answer: No, there is no cancellation fee before dispatch according to the policy. Delivery charges and return collection charges are displayed at checkout or specified in return requests. Support should verify order details before quoting amounts.

evidence.title: Fees and delivery charges
evidence.content: There is no store cancellation fee for an eligible order cancelled before dispatch. Delivery charges and any return collection charge are displayed at checkout or in the specific return request. Support must check the applicable order details before quoting an amount.

policy.question: How do I place an order through checkout?

answer.answer: To place an order through checkout, choose a product, select quantity and options, add it to the basket, complete checkout by reviewing the delivery address, charges, and payment method, then confirm.

evidence.title: Place an order
evidence.content: To place an order, choose an available product, select quantity and options, add it to the basket and complete checkout. Review the delivery address, charges and payment method before confirming. Product availability and final prices must be checked in the store checkout; this support application cannot place an order or reserve stock.

Audio fixtures use Apple speech synthesis, not human customer recordings; WER does not measure accent or noise robustness.
Policy reference-term checks can miss semantic mistakes and penalise correct paraphrases.
